migration_flags.description: The 'private' address type (5th selection option in v16/v17) is absent from v19. Selection values are now: contact, invoice, delivery, other (4 values).
migration_flags.impact: Any v16/v17 records with type='private' will require migration mapping to an alternative type. HR module integrations that relied on private type need to be reviewed.

migration_flags.description: The 'title' field (res.partner.title many2one, providing Mr/Ms/Dr salutations) is absent from base/models/res_partner.py in v19. Zero matches found in full file scan.
migration_flags.evidence: base/models/res_partner.py — full scan returned 0 occurrences of 'title'
migration_flags.impact: Title data from v16/v17 res.partner.title has no direct destination field. Salutation data must be mapped or stored elsewhere.

migration_flags.description: The 'mobile' field is absent from base/models/res_partner.py in v19. Zero matches found in full file scan.
migration_flags.evidence: base/models/res_partner.py — full scan returned 0 occurrences of 'mobile'
migration_flags.impact: Mobile number data migration path must be verified; the field may exist in a separate module (e.g. phone_validation).

migration_flags.description: credit and debit monetary fields are defined only in account/models/partner.py (lines 516-540). They are NOT present in the base model and are computed from account.move.line SQL aggregation.
migration_flags.impact: Integrations that read credit/debit without account module will fail. These fields require account module to be installed.

migration_flags.description: The barcode field is company_dependent=True in v19 (base/models/res_partner.py:309), meaning it has per-company values. In v16 it may have been a plain Char field.
migration_flags.impact: Barcode data migration must account for the company-dependent storage mechanism (ir.property or jsonb column depending on ORM version).
